scope: Only two finite validators: unqualified future-news current price-zero predicate, and known observed same-contract price role versus prior-day-own-change/future numeric target. No new word families, model/API/DB/service/core operations.

checks.future_announcement_price_zero: Original c318 unqualified 当前不影响TTF价格 is rejected even when the physical maintenance start is future. Missing current flow measurements are not proof that TTF prices cannot react to news. Conditional/expected/weak-pressure propositions and explicit unknown evidence remain permitted; a known comparable reaction source is required for an asserted absence of reaction.
checks.legal_direct_source_boundary: Exact previously adjudicated legal-source 无直接影响 remains permitted only as the source-limited absent direct delivery/supply channel. This review creates no general direct-word exemption from price observation requirements.
checks.observed_numeric_role: Only an as_of-known same-contract comparison rebuilt from source prices/date/clocks can supply a quoted observed delta, level or percentage. Current-versus-previous delta, current level introduced with 至/到, direction sign, monetary-energy unit and rounding at stated precision are checked separately.
checks.no_future_target_by_matching_number: A known observed0.178 does not permit a forecast of0.178, nor does a known87.725 price level permit a87.725 delta. The same sentence containing an observation followed by a numeric future target is still rejected per predicate.
checks.prior_day_own_change: Exact failed Enisecond 前一交易日价格上涨0.178 remains rejected with time-role explanation; it does not become a correct observation by matching a known number. A legitimate 当前报价较前一交易日上涨0.178 is allowed. Prior failed record is not retroactively promoted.
checks.no_input_or_label_change: AST comparison changes exactly _validate_prediction_semantics and _check_observed_absence_of_price_reaction. No top-level definitions added, source extraction/formatter/prepared input/prompt/schema/budgets unchanged, no output labels or numbers rewritten.

evidence.original_bad_raw_checks: Owner immutable proof37ecc6ce binds eighteen known-bad bodies and the exact Enitime role body; focused tests retain their rejection.

qualifications: These finite validator checks are not a universal numeric/causal-language proof or actual market accuracy result.
The retained future actual still contains its original P2; source fix acceptance does not replace its recorded prediction.

Full unit suite and official complete request/retry/error-path replay remain required after authorized application. Older generation-source metadata must be preserved even if the complete request is equivalent.
Fresh final-source required cases and a successful full production live/manual/detail/English workflow are still needed before release readiness.
